entities.name: UniProt P40042
observations: Exact 185-residue sequence match to reviewed Saccharomyces cerevisiae regulator of rDNA transcription protein 13 (100% identity and coverage; E-value 1.11e-134).
UniProt description says it may be involved in modulation of rDNA transcription; functional wording is tentative.
Length 185 aa; estimated molecular mass 20,686 Da; theoretical pI 5.825; GRAVY -0.0643; instability index 27.448.
Reference annotation lists WD repeats at residues 9–48, 71–108, and 111–148; Pfam detected WD40 profiles at residues 2–39 and 67–99.
No explicit catalytic reaction was retrieved; this is not proof that the protein lacks enzymatic activity.
